data.inventory_semantics: Virtual graph-token inventory. Every disconnected fragment is retained;tautomers,formal charges and stereochemistry are preserved. Covalent alkali-carbonate graph tokens are intentional model encodings,not a claim about ionic vendor stock. A one-step route is stock-compatible only if its complete encoded precursor pool has the same all-fragment graph identity as this pool. No fragment may be silently discarded.
data.selection_policy: Among accepted one-step model proposals,select the highest route score compatible with the complete virtual inventory. Scores are model outputs,not experimental success probabilities.
data.forward_protocol: Submit the selected proposal original metadata.reactants token string verbatim to the forward checkpoint. Graph equivalence is used for stock and target comparison;neural tokenization is not assumed invariant under alternative equivalent SMILES encodings.
data.model_scope: Fixed CPU digital prediction audit only;agreement between two learned models does not establish experimental feasibility,selectivity,yield or safe laboratory conditions. No laboratory action is requested.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: Route scores and model confidence are dimensionless;SMILES denote exact graph-token encodings under the declared complete-fragment policy.
